company.name: Chari
company.shortDescription: Chari is a B2B e-commerce that serves entrepreneurs with a steady supply of consumer products and financial services to meet their needs.
company.description: Chari is an e-commerce and fintech app for traditional retailers in French-Speaking Africa allowing them to order any consumer goods they sell and get delivered for free in less than 24 hours. Chari is also a financial services provider for these retailers, offering them microloans. Chari's mission is to meet the needs of entrepreneurs by supplying them with consumer goods on a regular basis and providing them with financial services.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 14 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $50,000, representing 0.24% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $101,593,762 to $144,437,685, a 1.42x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
